content: Service Name J1939Tp_ Transmit Syntax Std_ Return Type J1939Tp_ Transmit ( Pdu Id Type Tx Pdu Id, const Pdu Info Type* Pdu Info Ptr ) Service ID [hex] 0x49 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different Pdu Ids. Non reentrant for the same Pdu Id. Parameters (in) Tx Pdu Id Identifier of the PDU to be transmitted Pdu Info Ptr Length of and pointer to the PDU data and pointer to Meta Data. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: Transmit request has been accepted. E_ NOT_ OK: Transmit request has not been accepted. Description Requests transmission of a PDU. Available via J1939Tp.h
